purpose: Use one Active Project Folder across the entire web app.
behavior: Topbar Active Project Folder is the only visible project selector.
Billing, Projected, Actual, Inventory, Budget, Reports, Project Files and Smart Upload mirror the same project automatically.
Old per-module project memories are cleared so a hidden selector cannot restore a conflicting project.
Add Billing and Add Inventory forms also inherit the active project.
after_upload: Wait for Vercel Ready, then run v28.18-single-project-folder-release.sql once.
